data.description: Burj View | Connected to Dubai Mall
data.long_description:
Experience elevated luxury in this ultra-spacious 4-bedroom Penthouse at Boulevard Point, Downtown Dubai. With expansive interiors, abundant natural light, and uninterrupted Burj Khalifa views from every room, this home is designed to impress.

The highlight: a massive living/dining area and grand master bedroom, offering a lifestyle of true elegance and comfort.

Penthouse Features:

Generous Living Space:
Living/Dining: 7.5m x 7.5m – perfect for entertaining
Closed Kitchen: 4.3m x 3.3m – with window & gas stove
Master Bedroom: 7.4m x 3.3m – ultra-spacious & serene

Natural Light & Stunning Views:

Full Burj Khalifa views from living and all 4 bedrooms
Sunset-facing orientation for golden-hour ambiance

Functional & Private Layout:

4 Bedrooms | 6 Bathrooms
Built-Up Area: 2924.88 sq.ft
Two separate entrances – ideal for privacy and flexibility
Closed kitchen with an outside window – perfect for culinary enthusiasts

At a Glance:

Iconic 68-storey luxury tower
Direct access to Dubai Mall (Podium level shopping)
Frontage on Mohammed Bin Rashid Boulevard
Premium location in the heart of Downtown Dubai

World-Class Amenities:

Elegant double-height reception lobby with lounge
Infinity pool overlooking the Burj Khalifa
Fully equipped state-of-the-art gym
Podium-level retail, cafés, and everyday conveniences
Boulevard Point is part of the Dubai Mall extension, offering direct indoor access to the city’s most iconic shopping and dining destinations. This residence combines the energy of urban living with the comfort of a luxurious home — perfect for those who demand space, style, and a prime address.

Discover Downtown Dubai living at its finest — at Boulevard Point.
